events.title: NVIDIA publishes an OpenShell architecture and previews Sentry
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 OpenShell 架构并预告 Sentry
events.summary: NVIDIA published a reference architecture around the Apache-2.0 OpenShell agent runtime. OpenShell separates gateway, supervisor, sandbox and policy-prover controls from the agent workload. NVIDIA also previewed Sentry, a BlueField-4 hardware-isolated layer for traffic inspection, memory introspection and containment; Sentry is planned for early 2027, while OpenShell code is available now.

events.title: Ai2 releases FairStress to test hidden asymmetry in LLM decisions
events.title_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress 测试 LLM 决策中的隐性不对称
events.summary: Ai2 released FairStress, an open benchmark that tests whether matched persuasive prefixes change LLM decisions differently across demographic groups. It expands 300 scenarios across 29 high-stakes domains into more than 13 million cases, with a 50K-item core subset, public CC-BY-4.0 data and code. The benchmark uses an equality-centered definition of fairness and does not cover every equity framework.
events.summary_en: Ai2 released FairStress, an open benchmark that tests whether matched persuasive prefixes change LLM decisions differently across demographic groups. It expands 300 scenarios across 29 high-stakes domains into more than 13 million cases, with a 50K-item core subset, public CC-BY-4.0 data and code. The benchmark uses an equality-centered definition of fairness and does not cover every equity framework.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress，测试成对的说服性前缀是否会因人口群体不同而让 LLM 以不同幅度改变决定。它把 29 个高风险领域的 300 个场景扩展为 1300 多万个测试，并提供 5 万条核心子集、CC-BY-4.0 数据与公开代码。该 benchmark 采用以平等为中心的公平定义，不能覆盖所有公平观。
events.why_it_matters: For teams placing models in hiring, lending, healthcare or education workflows, final-answer parity can hide unstable decision criteria. Use FairStress as a predeployment stress test, while keeping domain policy and human review separate.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams placing models in hiring, lending, healthcare or education workflows, final-answer parity can hide unstable decision criteria. Use FairStress as a predeployment stress test, while keeping domain policy and human review separate.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对把模型用于招聘、信贷、医疗或教育流程的团队，只看最终答案一致可能掩盖不稳定的判断标准。FairStress 适合作为上线前压力测试，但不能替代领域政策与人工复核。

events.title: NVIDIA releases Kumo Relational for zero-training database prediction
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Kumo Relational，直接在关系数据库上预测
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released Kumo Relational, an open-weight model that predicts rows in relational databases from a task prompt and up to 10,000 historical examples in context. It combines row embeddings with relational message passing and supports classification and regression without task-specific training. The model uses the OpenMDW 1.1 license, while the supporting library is Apache-2.0.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布开放权重模型 Kumo Relational。它根据任务描述和最多 1 万条历史样例，直接对关系数据库中的行做预测。模型把行嵌入与关系消息传递结合起来，可在不做任务专属训练的情况下完成分类和回归。模型采用 OpenMDW 1.1 许可，配套库为 Apache-2.0。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams maintaining tabular ML pipelines, this could replace feature engineering and per-task retraining for some database prediction jobs. The vendor benchmark and custom model license require a controlled trial before architectural commitment.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护表格机器学习流水线的团队来说，它可能在部分数据库预测任务中减少特征工程和逐任务训练。厂商 benchmark 与自定义模型许可都要求先做受控试验，再决定架构投入。

events.title: Study finds document converters erase cues that policy agents need
events.title_zh: 研究发现文档转换会抹掉 policy agent 需要的视觉提示
events.summary_en: A study of 76 real policy documents finds that common ingestion pipelines drop meaning encoded in highlights, colour and other formatting. A deterministic OOXML scorer reports micro-F1 falling from 0.690 with preserved cues to 0.150 with Docling and 0.075 with plain text across six answering models. The paper provides a concrete failure mode but no public code or independent reproduction.
events.summary_zh: 一项覆盖 76 份真实政策文档的研究发现，常见文档摄取流程会丢掉高亮、颜色等格式中承载的含义。研究用确定性的 OOXML 规则评分：保留提示时 micro-F1 为 0.690，经 Docling 后降到 0.150，纯文本则为 0.075；这个结果在六个回答模型上重复出现。论文给出了明确故障模式，但没有公开代码或独立复现。
events.why_it_matters_en: For RAG and document-agent teams, text extraction can silently change policy meaning before retrieval or reasoning begins. Validation needs layout-aware test cases and provenance for author emphasis, not just OCR accuracy.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 RAG 和文档 agent 团队来说，文本抽取可能在检索和推理开始前就悄悄改变政策含义。验收不能只看 OCR 准确率，还要加入版式提示测试和作者强调信息的来源追踪。

events.title: OpenAI announces prior review for services that resell direct model access
events.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布直接转售模型访问需事先审核

events.title: Recursive releases Flint as an open-weight sparse coding model
events.title_zh: Recursive 发布开放权重稀疏 coding model Flint
events.summary_en: Recursive released Flint, a 39.8B-parameter mixture-of-experts coding model with about 2.5B active parameters per token and a 262K context window. BF16 weights are Apache-2.0, with SGLang and vLLM instructions; Ollama 0.40.8 adds a roughly 23 GB package for macOS. Other Ollama GPU support is promised later, and benchmarks remain publisher-run.
events.summary_zh: Recursive 发布 Flint：一个 398 亿参数的 MoE coding model，每个 token 约激活 25 亿参数，上下文窗口为 262K。BF16 权重采用 Apache-2.0，model card 提供 SGLang 和 vLLM 用法；Ollama 0.40.8 为 macOS 增加约 23 GB 的本地包。其他 GPU 的 Ollama 支持仍待后续，benchmark 也只有发布方结果。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams running coding models locally, Flint offers a small active footprint with a long context and permissive weights. A bounded trial should measure patch validity, latency, memory and repeated-run variance.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地运行 coding model 的团队来说，Flint 用较小激活参数量提供长上下文和宽松许可权重。试验应测补丁有效性、延迟、显存和重复运行波动。

events.title: Anthropic opens the Claude Duet proactive agent as a US waitlist preview
events.title_zh: Anthropic 以美国候补名单形式开放主动 agent Claude Duet
events.summary: Anthropic opened a research preview waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive agent that runs on its own cloud computer, uses connected apps and messages the user when work finishes or needs approval. The preview starts with Claude Pro and Max subscribers in the US, shares plan usage limits with regular Claude, and is not available to Team or Enterprise plans.
